doc.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21

title: Chicago, St. Louis spots and Dean O'Banion
summary: Pops on Chicago and St. Louis as musician towns, then Mugsy on a fight with the gangster Dean O'Banion.
